name: Yuga 2
description: Yuga 2 was the second planet in the Yuga system. It was covered in rain forests. The world played host to the popular Yuga Planetary Park, a tourist destination visited by Galaxy Tours. It was the site of a raid on a Galaxy Tours cruiser by Callow Batta prior to the Battle of Hoth.
